new: BrowseCraft is now called AltBrowse. Nothing to do: the update installs over BrowseCraft, keeps your profiles, bookmarks, passwords, extensions and settings exactly as they were, and renames the Start menu and desktop shortcuts.
fixed: Widevine (what Netflix, Spotify and Audible need) is now replaced in one piece when it updates, so an update while AltBrowse is open can no longer leave it half-copied.
